episodes.title: Vua Midas và Bàn Tay Vàng
summary: A Vietnamese bedtime retelling of The Golden Touch, Nathaniel Hawthorne's version of the King Midas myth.
King Midas wishes that all he touches turns to gold, then loses food, roses and, for a moment, his daughter Marygold.
A gentle lesson for kids: water, bread and the people we love are worth more than all the gold in the world.

episodes.title: Tư duy phản biện khi agent làm việc thay mình
summary: Addy Osmani viết trên X về tư duy phản biện khi agent AI làm phần lớn công việc thay ta.
Từ giao việc, phó thác đến đầu hàng nhận thức: hãy đặt giả thuyết trước, hỏi dấu xanh chứng minh gì và đọc bằng chứng.
Bạn giao được việc và phần lớn khâu kiểm tra, nhưng không giao được trách nhiệm cho thứ mình ship.

source.title: Critical thinking when agents do the work
source.author: Addy Osmani (@addyosmani)

episodes.title: The most lucrative AI business to start in 2027
summary: An X article by Dan Koe on the most lucrative AI business to start in 2027.
His thesis: capturing attention is the top skill, and one person using AI well can be a full creative team for their own brand or for clients.
It lays out a step-by-step client process and a way to land the first client, with market data from Goldman Sachs and the IAB.

source.title: The most lucrative AI business to start in 2027
source.author: DAN KOE (@thedankoe)

episodes.title: The road to self-improving software
summary: An X article by Ben Holmes on building a closed-loop software factory with agents.
Agents can proactively fix alerted bugs, score their own sessions to improve skills, and mine customer data for the roadmap.
It shifts the goal from faster pull requests to one loop from task to shipped product, with humans still reviewing.

episodes.title: How we scaled our app to 40 thousand dollars a month with zero dollars spent
summary: An X article by app co-founder Nicholas on growing an app to about 40 thousand dollars a month with organic video.
The method: a decent app built fast, heavy daily posting with trial reels, AI-assisted editing, and tested calls to action.
It is a sponsored, self-reported playbook; some tactics, like buying followers or planted comments, carry real risks.
